pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the main MIMEDefang process.

socket_dir.description: Directory where the main socket and child sockets will be created.

user.description: Unix user to run MIMEDefang processes as (must be non-root for security).

group.description: Unix group to run MIMEDefang processes as.

temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files during message processing.

max_children.description: Maximum number of child processes to handle incoming mail.

min_children.description: Minimum number of child processes to keep running.

min_spare_children.description: Minimum number of idle (spare) child processes to maintain.

max_spare_children.description: Maximum number of idle (spare) child processes before killing extras.

max_requests_per_child.description: Number of requests each child process handles before being recycled.

socket_perms.description: File permissions (octal) for the main Unix socket.

socket_owner.description: Owner (username) for the main Unix socket (optional; usually root).

socket_group.description: Group for the main Unix socket (must be accessible by MTA).

timeout.description: Overall timeout (in seconds) for a single mail transaction.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for connecting to external services (e.g., clamd, spamd).

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) before a child process exits.

transaction_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for the entire mail transaction per message.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., LOCAL0, MAIL).

syslog_level.description: Minimum syslog level to log (e.g., debug, info, notice, warning, err).

log_to_file.description: Enable logging to a file (in addition to syslog).

log_file.description: Path to the file where logs will be written if log_to_file is true.

log_pid.description: Include PID in each log line.

log_timestamps.description: Include ISO timestamps in each log line.

log_level_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (includes message headers in logs).

action.description: Default action if no filters reject the message (accept, quarantine, delete, discard, rewrite).

quarantine_action.description: Action to take when message is quarantined (quarantine, delete, rewrite_headers).

quarantine_compress.description: Compress quarantined messages with gzip for space savings.

quarantine_perms.description: File permissions (octal) for quarantined files (typically restrictive).

replace_bad_headers.description: Replace illegal or dangerous headers (e.g., null bytes, excessive length) with safe placeholders.

strip_attachments.description: Strip all attachments (dangerous for most sites; usually disabled).

strip_extensions.description: Remove dangerous file extensions (e.g., .exe, .bat) from attachments.

strip_extensions_list.description: List of file extensions to automatically strip or quarantine.

items.description: A single file extension (lowercase, no dot).

virus_action.description: Action for messages that contain viruses (quarantine, delete, accept_with_warning).

spam_action.description: Action for messages flagged as spam (accept, quarantine, reject).

spam_tag_level.description: SpamAssassin score at which to add 'X-Spam-Status' header.

spam_tag2_level.description: Score at which to add 'X-Spam-Flag' header and mark subject.

spam_kill_level.description: Score at which to discard or quarantine (based on spam_action).

clamd_socket.description: Path or TCP address:port for ClamAV daemon (e.g., unix:/var/run/clamav/clamd.sock or 127.0.0.1:3310).

freshclam_pidfile.description: Path to the freshclam PID file (used to verify ClamAV is updated).

spamd_socket.description: Path or TCP address:port for SpamAssassin daemon (e.g., unix:/var/run/spamd.sock or 127.0.0.1:783).

spamd_host.description: Host for remote SpamAssassin (only used if spamd_socket is not a Unix socket).

spamd_port.description: Port for remote SpamAssassin (only used if spamd_socket is not a Unix socket).

spamd_user.description: User to switch to when running SpamAssassin locally (if used directly).

filter.description: List of Perl filter scripts to run (semicolon-separated string in INI).

items.description: Absolute path to a Perl filter script.

disable_milter.description: Disable MTA integration (useful for testing; not for production).

milter_socket.description: Socket path for MTA to communicate with MIMEDefang (Sendmail/Postfix milter interface).

milter_socket_owner.description: Owner of the Milter socket (MTA must be able to access it).

milter_socket_group.description: Group of the Milter socket (MTA must be in this group or have permissions).

milter_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for MTA milter communication.

use_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support (for network sockets and DNS).

dns_retries.description: Number of times to retry DNS lookups before failing.

rate_limit_by.description: Rate limit by client IP, sender, or recipient.

rate_limit_log_file.description: Log file path for rate limiting entries (if rate_limit_log is true).

db_path.description: Base directory for database files (if persistent state is enabled).
